metadata.how: pooled over every committed snapshot at this rules_cksum, deduplicated by response text, plus a dedicated n=40 generation per cell
metadata.what: laconic never-cut failure rates per cell, measured under master rules
metadata.why: the fatal counters compared a round's per-cell count against a single n=10 baseline draw; these are the rates that draw was estimating. A rate of 0 clears nothing: the screen only ever speaks for a cell that demonstrably fails on its own.
